text: In many public libraries, a reference librarian can help trace a reliable source or find local records; bring a question, even if it’s still a rough one.
The Rosetta Stone helped scholars decipher Egyptian hieroglyphs because its decree appeared in three scripts, turning careful comparison into a bridge across centuries.
Spend three minutes clearing one small surface at home: return stray items to their usual places, and leave the area ready for its next use.
